text: Rahul - dad passed Sat. funeral Thurs @ 11, crematorium in Slough. send card + ask if he needs anything

Noah's taking the morning off to walk her in, then his wife does pickup. he said he'll probably cry in the car after. ask him how drop off went

Khadija: brother Yusuf got into Leeds medicine!! offer came thru yesterday

pick up passport from post office b4 Fri. renewal took 6 wks

Jen - new job @ NHS from Mon. ask how 1st wk went
Björn back from Iceland. saw northern lights 2 nights running. wants to go back for the ice caves

Julien - no more Montreal. job fell through, whole relocation cancelled. staying in Bristol for now
Marisol's dog Churro had his op on Mon (knee). home now, cone of shame. she's shattered
Ibrahim + Layla - 10th anniv June 3rd. thinking Amalfi coast. he wants to surprise her, don't say anything
Yusuf's PhD viva 2 November 2026. terrified. msg good luck nite before!!
Emily - mum's diagnosis confirmed, scans again Dec 2nd. Emily going part time to look after her. ring Sun
Emre loves Turkish coffee, v fussy abt it. only drinks from a cezve. xmas gift idea?
Jack's daughter Chloe - first day of Year 7 today. new school, big bus on her own. ask Jack how she got on
Lin flying to Chengdu 12/18 for New Year w/ family, back Jan 9. first time home in 4 yrs
Imogen - graduated! First in Architecture. ceremony was last Weds. send congrats card

Lola & her bf Jack broke up after 6 yrs. found out he'd been talking to his ex the whole of last summer. she's at her sister Saskia's in Brighton for a bit, signed off work till 11/3. not eating much apparently. the flat's in both names so that's a whole mess too. go easy, don't ask about him. take her for brunch when she's back, somewhere new not our usual

Saskia - redundancy consultation mtg Oct 30. 3rd round this yr. she thinks it's her turn, whole dept being moved to Kraków. not sleeping, stress eating, said she's been snapping at the kids. she's quietly updating her CV, has a call w/ a recruiter Fri. remind me to ring her the evening of the 30th, and send her the LinkedIn guy Kumar's details
Tunde runs Sat parkrun every wk. training for Berlin marathon Sept 2027
Simone hates flying - takes a sedative even for short hops. Barcelona trip Apr 22nd w/ hen party, poor thing

Kiara - nan died last wk, 94. funeral Fri 24th in Kingston, Jamaica. she's flying out Wed, back Nov 4. nan basically raised her, lived w/ them till Kiara was 12. her mum's taking it really hard, hasn't left the house. Kiara's handling all the arrangements from here. msg before she goes, offer to water plants + feed the fish
Chloe's twins finish nursery July 18th, start primary in Sept. she's emotional abt it
Ryan - driving test round 3, Nov 6. failed twice on roundabouts. v nervous. good luck text am of
dentist moved to 11/12 @ 9:40. need to rearrange the 1:1 w/ team
Layla - vegan now, also no gluten. remember for her bday dinner
Aurelio says his mum's 70th is in Naples, May 9th 2027. whole family going, 30+ ppl. he's organising, stressed
Rahul (Raz) - sister Pooja's wedding in Jaipur Feb 2027, 4 days. he's asked if I can come

Efua's cat Kofi went missing Sun. posters up round Hackney, been on every local Facebook group, the vets have his chip details. he's never been gone more than a night. she's in bits, walking the streets at 2am shaking the treat bag. her flatmate Simone thinks he got shut in a garage. share the post on the street WhatsApp
follow up: Noah's interview @ Deloitte was Thurs. haven't heard. ask him Mon
Fang mentioned she's always wanted a proper film camera. Leica too much but a decent used Olympus wd go down well
Aditi - dad's knee replacement Dec 8th. she's going to Pune for 2 wks to help. check in when she lands
Delroy & Natasha (his partner) - housewarming Nov 22. I'm doing the cake
Khadija - Ramadan this yr in Feb/Mar 2027 so no lunches then. works @ Barclays, Canary Wharf
call w/ Salma. she started a pottery class Thurs nites, loving it. new job at the council going ok too
Marisol (Mari) - daughter Imogen's grad from Edinburgh Uni, June 28th 2027. already booked the train
Natasha - interview 4/2 at Channel 4, producer role. she sounded calm but she's not. good luck msg Weds
Jen's Grandad Delroy (Pops) - 90th on Dec 5. party at the golf club. get card, maybe whisky

Björn and his wife Saskia expecting #2, due April 2027. little Noah will be a big brother. Saskia had awful morning sickness first 3 months, better now. they're thinking of moving out of the flat before the baby comes, looking at houses near her parents in Uppsala. Björn would have to go remote, his boss hasn't said yes yet
Pooja + Julien off to Peru 3/15, Machu Picchu trek. 3 flights to get there. ask abt altitude meds

Ibrahim - lost his job at the agency, out of nowhere. 8 yrs there, called into HR Tues 9am and out the door by lunch. he's ok-ish, already applying, has a 2nd stage w/ an ad firm in Shoreditch 10/29. wife Layla's on mat leave so money's tight. grab a pint w/ him next wk, my shout. also send him Emily's contact, she's hiring
Marisol's mum (Mrs Johnson) - hip op went well Fri. walking w/ frame. send flowers

Yusuf moved to Manchester for his postdoc. lives in Didsbury, shares w/ 2 others. misses London food. supervisor is Prof Nakamura, v intense apparently. he's into bouldering now, goes 3x a wk, wants to do Font next spring. allergic to nuts, remember if he visits

Tunde & Simone - leaving drinks for Tunde Fri 7th @ The Crown. he's off to Dubai, new job starts Dec 1. Simone moving out in Jan once she's finished her contract. she's not sure about it tbh, all very fast. get him a leaving card + something for the flight
Emily's sister Layla got her A level results - A*AA, off to Durham. Emily was crying on the phone. Layla starts uni Oct 4th
Imogen's fiancé Julien - stag in Prague Mar 2027, wedding Aug 21st 2027. save the date for the wedding
Emre called - his granddad's funeral in Izmir was today. couldn't fly out, watched on video. gutted. check how he is tmrw
Jack's son Tunde - 11+ exam Sept 13. mock went badly, Tunde crying abt it. Jack asked if I know any tutors. find Ms Adeyemi's number for him
Lin + Lola (yes they're together now!) - joint 30th party Mar 2027, boat on the Thames

long flight Sun 10/26 LHR-SFO, 11hrs. book seat (aisle!), download films, charge headphones, sort ESTA. hotel checkin 3pm local, conference Mon-Weds, then 2 days in Yosemite if the weather holds. flight back 11/1 overnight, straight into work Mon. ugh. pack the big adapter
Saskia's kid Lin lost her first tooth, tooth fairy left £2. Saskia's hubby Aurelio thinks that's inflation
Chloe - dad passed in 2019, anniversary's Nov 15. she always goes quiet that wk. text her on the day
Kiara - got the job @ Unilever! starts Jan 5 2027. she was sure she'd messed up the 2nd interview. congrats msg + drinks soon. her boss will be Dr Osei, the one who was her lecturer at uni

Ryan's brother Noah - Thailand + Vietnam backpacking til March 2027. leaves 10/28, 14hr flight to Bangkok via Doha. Ryan's mum v worried, keeps sending him articles abt scams. Noah's never been further than Spain. Ryan driving him to Heathrow. ask Ryan in Nov if he's heard from him
Rahul + Efua + Noah - pub quiz Thurs. Rahul back after the funeral, Efua's thesis due 1/31. Noah says he's thinking of quitting. didn't push, but ask him next time
